status: Proposal only; not implemented, profiled or trained
experiment: Audio-only qualification before any renewed FGN comparison
input: Existing 80-bin fbank, train-only normalization, unchanged chunk-boundary availability

chunk_head.input: Flatten the final eight stride-4 representations, including the chunk's last available frame
chunk_head.contract: Every output may depend on every arrived frame through the chunk head; no later chunk is visible

parameter_count_note: Analytical count for the proposed modules, not an instantiated-model measurement

training.phase_1: Representation MAE only; check a fixed tiny training subset can be fitted and held-out MAE beats a training-only constant baseline
training.phase_2: Add KL only after the representation gate; log per-loss weighted gradient norms and cosine, and preserve MAE-only checkpoint
training.coverage: Include utterance beginnings and ends in direct supervision; do not always exclude the first two chunks
training.duration: Fix epoch/step/time limits and stopping checks before launch; not specified or executed here

qualification.baseline: Same-run full encoder pipeline, including fbank and native decoding
qualification.additional_cost_record: Also report audio-network-only time relative to the full encoder's neural time
qualification.meaning: Entry gate for renewed B/C tests, not accuracy-preserving acceleration versus the 2.93% teacher
qualification.failure_scope: Stop this bounded recipe; do not claim impossibility for all fbank-conditioned correctors

follow_up_if_qualified: A/B/C with 2-3 training seeds, common data/initialization/budgets, full-sequence corrected-state feedback and all forecast costs charged
